annotations.title: Verify a list of email addresses (bulk job)

description: Submit an async bulk email verification job (up to 1,000 emails per request; duplicate addresses are verified and billed once). Returns a request_id — poll with get_bulk_job_status. Uses credits: 1 credit per address with a definitive result (valid, invalid or risky), charged when the job completes; unknown results are free.

emails.description: List of email addresses to verify

webhook_url.description: Optional public http(s) URL that gets one POST when the job completes. It carries counts only (campaign_id, which equals the request_id, plus total, valid, invalid, risky and unknown counts), not per-address results; fetch those with get_bulk_job_status. Delivered once, not retried.

name: verify_emails_bulk
